programmes.d: After a U.S. intelligence negotiator goes missing and her ransacked Paris apartment is discovered to be covered in her blood, the team is on the clock to find her before the country's nuclear secrets fall into the wrong hands.
When an American founder of an illegal adults-only site is killed in Prague, the team is tasked to locate his co-founder, who is still on the run in the Czech Republic.
When a group of Americans is among the victims of a bombing at a festival in Budapest, the team is brought in to find the perpetrators before they strike again.
The team jets to Bulgaria when terrorists hold hostage for millions in cryptocurrency a concert hall filled with multinational student performers and their families.
As the team searches for a young girl who was kidnapped from a cabin during a family vacation, they discover that the abduction may be tied to a skeleton in her family's closet.

The team must infiltrate a drug trafficking gang after the robbery of a chemical plant leaves two customs agents dead. Also, Nestor offers his help on the case, giving Maggie new insight into his character.

As the team hunts a killer who is shooting seemingly unrelated targets, an experience on the job has a new agent Tiffany, examining the tension between her career as an FBI agent and the responsibility she feels to her community as a Black woman.
After a bomb leaves three people dead, the team passes a reluctant informant to gather information from his close friends who are under suspicion.
When a political reporter is kidnapped and held without a ransom demand, the team must dig into her past relationship in order to pin down her assailants motive.

Kellett and the Fly Team reluctantly join an investigation in Northern Ireland, when one of Kellett's shifty yet valuable informants who's arrested for his connection to a robbery and murder, calls her to help clear his name.
When an NYPD officer is detained in Transnistria for aggravated assault, the Fly Team investigates his claims of infiltrating a sex trafficking ring being concealed by those in power.
When a notorious American tech tycoon becomes involved in a murder in Frankfurt, the Fly Team must chase him down amid the local protesters he's incited with his conspiracy theories on social media.

When a couple flees to Albania while awaiting sentencing for bilking millions in COVID relief funds from the U.S. government, the Fly Team and Jaeger must contend with the wife's menacing crime family as they try to track the duo down.
The Fly Team must figure out how to keep the U.S. attorney general safe amid a possible security breach while she's in Hungary for an important meeting. Also, Raines' sister is in Budapest.
The team must track down two assailants who wear animal masks while committing armed robberies, with the latest leaving an off-duty 26 Fed security guard dead.
After a man is killed by an explosive package shipped to his home, the team attempts to capture the sender and intercept his latest deadly parcel.
The team rushes to track down two doctors abducted by a desperate father willing to do anything to save his son.
When the CEO of a major brokerage firm is shot and killed while surrounded by protestors, the team looks into who has the most to lose from his company's perceived manipulations.
While investigating a mass casualty incident at a New York City restaurant, the team scrambles to determine if it was racially motivated and if there was more than one gunman.
